newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE says to list six new equity options.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE says to list six new equity options.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Thursday it would introduce six new equity options in February.
With effect from Monday February 17 the Exchange will add British Biotech Plc, Great Universal Stores Plc, Centrica and BG Plc.

Centrica and BG will result from the planned demerger of British Gas Plc, Centrica comprising the British Gas UK trading and supply operations and BG its international interests which will include exploration production.
Equity options will also be available for trading on the shares of Energy Group Plc, following a four-way demerger of Hanson Plc. Hanson plans to float Energy Group early this year.
LIFFE said it will delist Hillsdown Holdings and Pilkington Plc options, due to low trading volume.

Sandy Phillips, Head of Equity Products at LIFFE said the range of products offered by the Exchange reflects member and client demand. "These new equity options will provide investors with valuable flexibility in managing exposure to the UK equity market."
